subject: Request: Trial Bridge & Technical Sync — Build Queue Delay
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@clearmap.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Build queue failure — asking for trial extension and sandbox credits

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note — our integration sprint hit a hard stop this morning. During a scheduled connector rollout with our data vendor we started getting intermittent 502s from the ingestion endpoint; the team suspects a schema/handshake mismatch and it’s blocking us from completing the end-to-end tests needed to go live. Our engineering lead estimates ~10 business days to verify fixes and re-run the ingest pipeline.

We’re still excited about Redwood and want to keep momentum, but the current trial window will expire mid-April and we won’t have reliable signal before then. Could you approve a two-week trial extension and a sandbox credit top-up so we can run a second round of tests after the vendor patch? A small amount of token runway and an extended window will make the difference for our pilot decision.

I’ve attached the initial error log snippet. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Integrations | Clearmap
[attachment: error_log.txt]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@clearmap.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build queue failure — asking for trial extension and sandbox credits

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the log. Sorry to hear this landed during the rollout. We can absolutely help here.

Before I escalate, two quick asks so we can scope the right support and credit amount:
- Can you share the full error log and the failing payload (redacted) or a reproducible curl?
- Does your team have a preferred time window for a short technical sync (30 min) this week? Marcus (SE) is copied — he can triage and propose a canary approach that minimizes token usage.

Proposed immediate options:
- Temporary 100k token sandbox top-up + two-week extension (internal approval pending)
- Or a smaller 25k bump if you’d prefer to limit our exposure while we triage together

I’ll await Marcus’s recommendation and Karthik will confirm commercial approval. If we can get a quick call today or tomorrow, we should be able to finalize by EOD.

—Kimberly Park
Account Director | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0112
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build queue failure — asking for trial extension and sandbox credits

Internal note / triage: attached the partial error_log.txt from Elena. Initial read: 502s with payload size amplification and repeated replays — likely client-side retry loop + an unexpected null field in the new vendor schema.

Quick plan:
1) Ask Clearmap engineering to reproduce locally with a reduced payload (I can provide a sanitized sample).
2) Spin a canary ingest route that drops retries and preserves original timestamps — run 10k events to validate no token overrun.
3) If canary looks good, we give them the bigger sandbox top-up.

Recommendation: approve the 100k token sandbox top-up and a two-week extension. I’m comfortable owning the sync and will produce a short runbook (runbook_v1.pdf) with the steps and guardrails.

Attachments: error_log.txt (partial), runbook_v1.pdf (draft)

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build queue failure — asking for trial extension and sandbox credits

Kimberly / Marcus — approved. Finance and trials team okayed a one-time 100k token sandbox credit and a two-week extension for Clearmap (deal CLM-4521). Please document the runbook and mark the credit as trial_topup#CLM-4521 in HubSpot.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@clearmap.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Build queue failure — asking for trial extension and sandbox credits

Elena — good news: we’ve approved a one-time 100k token sandbox top-up and extended your trial by two weeks (new expiry: 2027-04-30). Marcus will lead a short technical sync to walk through the runbook and a canary plan.

Next steps:
- Marcus: proposed sync Thursday 4/8 at 10am PT (link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=clearmap-technical-sync)
- Elena: please attach the full error payload or a sanitized sample before the sync
- We’ll log the credit as trial_topup#CLM-4521 in HubSpot and confirm when applied to your sandbox project this morning.

Attaching the draft runbook for visibility: runbook_v1.pdf.

Thanks — we’ll follow up after the call with the canary results and any additional recommendations.

Best,
Kimberly Park
